narrativeSections.additionalInfo: Welcome! This guided tutorial will teach you how to move, use the controls, and care for four injured patients. Listen carefully and follow the directions you hear.
Let's begin by learning how to move. Find the joystick on your left controller. Move the joystick in any direction to walk around the environment.
Look around and find the red square. Use the left joystick to walk over and stand inside it.
Press the left joystick down until you feel it click. Hold it down while moving to walk twice as fast. Move to the orange square.
Find the joystick on your right controller. Push and hold it forward to aim the green teleport beam at the blue square in the distance. Release the joystick to teleport there.
Teleport to the yellow square.
Go to the man lying on the ground by himself.
You may need to kneel or crouch to reach a patient. Place your hand on the patient's wrist or neck to check for a pulse.
Assess the patient's breathing. Watch for the chest to rise and fall, or ask the patient about their breathing. Ask the patient about their breathing now.
Find the medical bag on your right hip. Place your right hand on the bag and pull the trigger to grab it. Move the bag where you can see both the bag and the patient.
Release the trigger to place the bag.
The bag contains tools for treating patients. Move your hand over a tool to highlight it yellow. The amount remaining appears in the center of the bag.

Let's review the tools in your medical bag. Starting at the top left, you have a SAM splint, hemostatic gauze, chest seal, burn dressing, antibiotics, eye shield, and fentanyl lollipops. Starting at the bottom left, you have a tourniquet, gauze, Israeli bandage, space blanket, blood, nasal airway, and decompression needle. Below the bag are the TCCC triage tags: Red–Immediate, Yellow–Delayed, Green–Minimal, and Black–Expectant.
To select a tool, move your hand over it, then pull and hold the trigger. Release the trigger to let go of the tool.
Select the decompression needle and place it at the appropriate site on the patient's chest.
When you move away, the medical bag will automatically return to your hip. Move to the patient sitting on the ground nearby.
Move to the two Soldiers nearby. The Soldier trapped under the concrete needs treatment and must be moved to safety.
Patients may be outside your line of sight. Search nearby rooms, buildings, and other areas when needed. Go into the office building next to you and go upstairs to the second floor.
You have now assessed, treated, and tagged all four patients.
Good work.
